description: Manages external links associated with various business entities like Partners, Projects, or Contacts.

endpoints.name: GetLinks
endpoints.description: Retrieves a paginated list of links associated with a specific entity.

entity.description: The type of entity the links are associated with (e.g., Partner, Project, Contact).

entityId.description: The ID of the entity the links are associated with.

parameters.description: Pagination and sorting parameters. Contains 'PageIndex' (integer, required), 'PageSize' (integer, required), 'OrderBy' (string), 'Ascending' (boolean), 'Direction' (boolean).

example_uses: Get all links related to Partner with ID 123.
List links for Project 456, showing 10 links per page.
Retrieve links for Contact 789, ordered by name ascending.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to retrieve a list of external links associated with a specific business entity (e.g., Partner, Project, Contact).

endpoints.name: Create
endpoints.description: Creates a new link and associates it with a specified entity.

req.description: The request body containing link details. Requires 'Entity' (string) and 'EntityId' (integer). Can also include 'Url' (string) and 'Name' (string).

example_uses: Create a new link for Partner 123 with URL 'https://example.com/partner-info' and name 'Partner Website'.
Add a link 'Project Docs' pointing to 'https://docs.project.org' for Project 456.
Register a new external reference for Contact 789.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to add a new external link to an existing business entity.

endpoints.name: Update

req.description: The request body containing updated link details. Requires 'Id' (integer), 'Entity' (string), and 'EntityId' (integer). Can also include 'Url' (string) and 'Name' (string).

example_uses: Update the link with ID 1 for Partner 123, changing its URL to 'https://new-example.com'.
Modify the name of link ID 5 for Project 456 to 'Updated Project Docs'.
Change the URL and name of link ID 10 associated with Contact 789.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to modify the details (URL, name) of an existing external link.

endpoints.name: Delete
endpoints.description: Deletes a link by its ID.

id.description: The unique identifier of the link to delete.

example_uses: Remove the external reference identified by ID 45.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to remove an existing external link.
